query: UPDATE goals SET title = COALESCE($3, title), description = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE description END, deadline = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE deadline END, status = COALESCE($8, status), labels = COALESCE($9::text[], labels), visibility = COALESCE($10, visibility), updated_at = $11 WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
